# Angular Performance Optimizer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Angular

## Overview

Analyzes and optimizes Angular application performance through change detection tuning, bundle optimization, and runtime profiling

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [angular-performance-optimizer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
angular-performance-optimizer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@angular-performance-optimizer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Profile and optimize change detection cycles
- Implement OnPush strategy and pure pipes for rendering
- Configure tree shaking and dead code elimination
- Optimize bundle size with lazy loading and preloading

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Core Web Vitals**: LCP, FID, CLS targets for Angular applications
- **Bundle Analysis**: Webpack bundle analyzer for size optimization
- **Angular Performance**: Official performance checklist and optimization guide
